title: I made a satisfying squishy butter game
author: Fuzzy-Ratio-3275

comments.author: HopefulMeasurement25
comments.body: what if I want to throw it at the wall

replies.author: Fuzzy-Ratio-3275
replies.body: If you think that would be fun, why not? I might have to add a wall-throwing feature next.

replies.author: jazzuoDOTcom
replies.body: What about putting it on bread and eating....or eating from the wall?

comments.author: jazzuoDOTcom
comments.body: I got to play it. I thought it's Google play only (I hate downloading and deleting) but it's on net yeah. I like it. It's fun don't know what to do with it more. Anyway playing with I thought to my self could the butter be like 1mx1m and there would be a small ball or liquid and I would move it by squishing butter. Also I missed zooming with double touch.

replies.author: Fuzzy-Ratio-3275
replies.body:
Thank you very much for playing it and for the feedback. I really appreciate you taking the time to share your ideas.

I really like the idea of making the butter much bigger and having a small ball or liquid inside that you can move around by squishing the butter. That could make the gameplay much more interesting.

And yes, I’ll keep the double-touch zooming in mind as well. Thanks again for the ideas.
